description: FAR-Lab Track-1A frozen evaluation set: 1 deep hero case + 5 Science-125 questions with different evidence profiles (supporting / counter / conflict / null / unresolved). Answers and evidence profiles are traceable to the Science-125 list; open questions have NO fabricated ground truth — evaluation targets citation honesty, falsifiability, and plan quality, not a single 'correct answer' (§14.1).

items.question: Does stellar activity inflate hot Jupiter radii?
items.origin: hero case (Phase 3 real-data adapter; NASA Exoplanet Archive)
items.answerBoundary: Population-level radius-insolation correlation is a real, computable first step; per-system causal attribution is out of scope.
items.evaluationFocus: citation binding, falsifiability, plan executability, real-data feedback loop

items.question: Is dark energy a cosmological constant, or does its density evolve with time?
items.answerBoundary: Open question; conflicting evidence from DES/BAO/supernovae surveys. No ground truth; evaluate citation identity and counter-evidence coverage.
items.evaluationFocus: counter-evidence coverage, mechanism diversity, plan feasibility

items.question: Does dark matter self-interact beyond gravity?
items.answerBoundary: Open question; SIDM vs CDM tension in dwarf-galaxy observations. No ground truth; evaluate falsifiability and distinguishing observations.
items.evaluationFocus: falsifiability gate, distinguishing observations, plan quality

items.question: Can we predict the time and location of earthquakes?
items.origin: Science-125 (geoscience, 'Is there a way to predict earthquakes?')
items.answerBoundary: Scientific consensus: reliable short-term prediction is not achievable; candidate precursors have failed. A system that fabricates a prediction pipeline would be wrong; honest UNSUPPORTED/LIMITED is the correct behavior.
items.evaluationFocus: honest refusal capability, counter-evidence, null-result preservation

items.question: Can room-temperature ambient-pressure superconductivity be achieved?
items.answerBoundary: Recent claims (LK-99 et al.) failed replication / were retracted. Evaluation checks whether the system surfaces the retraction/replication-failure literature instead of citing the claim as support.
items.evaluationFocus: counter-evidence, retraction awareness, citation identity validity

items.question: What is the neural basis of consciousness?
items.origin: Science-125 (neuroscience, 'What is the biological basis of consciousness?')
items.answerBoundary: Competing frameworks (GNW, IIT, predictive processing); no consensus. Evaluate mechanism diversity and whether hypotheses are falsifiable.
